post.summary: Require the Composer package of a plugin
post.description: Requires the Composer package of a plugin whose `executeComposerCommands()` returns `true`, in the version found on disk. Call it in a request of its own before the install or update request. Composer runs in a copy of `vendor/`, `composer.json` and `composer.lock`, which replaces the live files only after Composer succeeded. Apps need no Composer step. Requires the `system.plugin_maintain` permission.

parameters.name: technicalName
parameters.description: The technical name of the extension.

200.description: Whether Composer required the package in this request.

composerRan.description: `false` when the extension is an app, the plugin needs no Composer run, or its package is installed in that version already.

400.description: Composer could not require the package.

409.description: Another Composer operation for plugins is running.

500.description: The vendor directory cannot be replaced, or an earlier operation stopped while it replaced it.

post.summary: Remove the Composer package of a plugin
post.description: Removes the Composer package of a plugin that the project required at runtime: after the uninstall of a plugin whose `executeComposerCommands()` returns `true`, or after an update to a version whose `executeComposerCommands()` returns `false`. Call it in a request of its own after the uninstall or update request. Packages outside `custom/` stay. Requires the `system.plugin_maintain` permission.

parameters.name: technicalName
parameters.description: The technical name of the extension.

200.description: Whether Composer removed the package in this request.

composerRan.description: `false` when the extension is an app or the plugin's package had nothing to remove.

400.description: Composer could not remove the package.

409.description: Another Composer operation for plugins is running.

500.description: The vendor directory cannot be replaced, or an earlier operation stopped while it replaced it.
